name: oriel
description: Oriel — espace de travail collaboratif open-source (pages, blocs, bases de données), auto-hébergeable.

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w server & npm run dev -w web
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w desktop
